get.description: Returns a paginated list of question items with child options and rubric details.

post.summary: Create a new question item with options and rubric (Instructor/Admin only)
post.description: Creates a new multi-type question item in the question bank.

get.summary: Get question detail with options and rubric items
get.description: Retrieves full question metadata, choices with distractor rationales, and analytical scoring rubric.

put.summary: Update question metadata or validation status (Instructor/Admin only)
put.description: Updates prompt, difficulty, Bloom level, or validation status of a question.

delete.summary: Delete a question item and cascade delete its options (Instructor/Admin only)
delete.description: Permanently deletes a question from the question bank.

post.summary: Generate curriculum-grounded questions with distractors using LLM (Instructor/Admin only)
post.description:
Synthesizes curriculum-grounded STEM questions using the LLM Gateway,
steered by Bloom's Taxonomy, with diagnostic distractor rationales and KaTeX formatting.
All generated items are automatically staged in PENDING_VALIDATION.

post.summary: Batch validate pending questions with blind solving, deduplication, and quality audit (Instructor/Admin only)
post.description: Executes the multi-gate validation pipeline on questions staged in PENDING_VALIDATION.

post.summary: Validate a question item for solvability, duplicates, and quality (Instructor/Admin only)
post.description:
Executes the 3-Gate Validation Pipeline on a single Question item:
1. Blind Solver Gate (solvability + agreement).
2. Vector Deduplication Gate (cosine similarity < 0.90).
3. Pedagogical Quality Audit (KaTeX, clarity, distractors, derivation).
Promotes question to VALIDATED, FLAGGED, or REJECTED.

post.summary: Record question attempt and update topic mastery via Bayesian Knowledge Tracing
post.description:
Submits a student's answer to a question, executes the BKT probabilistic update,
adapts the next item difficulty, and records telemetry.
